item.title: Pakistán lanza una ofensiva aérea contra Afganistán en respuesta a ataques con drones
item.description: Pakistán llevó a cabo ataques aéreos contra 10 ubicaciones en Afganistán que, según dijo, se estaban utilizando para lanzar y almacenar drones, algunos de los cuales se habían empleado contra Pakistán el día anterior, dijo el jueves el ministro de Información, Attaullah Tarar.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pakistán llevó a cabo ataques aéreos contra 10 ubicaciones en Afganistán que, según dijo, se estaban utilizando para lanzar y almacenar drones, algunos de los cuales se habían empleado contra Pakistán el día anterior, dijo el jueves el ministro de Información, Attaullah Tarar. Los ataques se producen en un momento en que se intensifican las tensiones entre los antiguos aliados convertidos en enemigos, que están cada vez más enfrentados por la expansión de las insurgencias en el oeste y el noroeste de Pakistán. Islamabad acusa a Kabul de dar cobijo a milicianos islamistas que llevan a cabo ataques transfronterizos; el Gobierno talibán de Afganistán lo niega, alegando que la militancia es un problema interno de Pakistán. Los sistemas de defensa aérea de Pakistán detectaron el miércoles drones lanzados desde territorio afgano, que fueron rastreados y neutralizados antes de que pudieran alcanzar ninguno de sus objetivos previstos, dijo Tarar en una publicación en la red social X. A continuación, Pakistán llevó a cabo "ataques aéreos y con drones de precisión" contra 10 ubicaciones, que se "limitaron a objetivos militares identificados" vinculados a los intentos de ataque, añadió. "Cualquier nuevo acto provocador por parte de los talibanes afganos recibirá una respuesta firme y resuelta", dijo el ministro. Los funcionarios talibanes negaron que su Gobierno hubiera lanzado drones contra Pakistán el miércoles. Los ataques aéreos pakistaníes del jueves alcanzaron varias zonas de las provincias sudorientales de Khost y Paktia, pero no causaron víctimas, informaron a Reuters dos portavoces talibanes. Un ataque contra una instalación policial en el noroeste de Pakistán la semana pasada, en el que murieron al menos 24 personas, ha reavivado los combates entre ambos países tras casi tres meses de relativa calma. El Gobierno de Pakistán también afirmó esta semana que había lanzado ataques aéreos en la región fronteriza entre Afganistán y Pakistán, en los que murieron [USN:L6N45D0KQ TEXT:"28 milicianos"], mientras que funcionarios talibanes afganos acusaron a Islamabad de matar a tres civiles en ataques nocturnos sobre territorio afgano. Sin embargo, el peor incidente aislado se produjo en marzo, cuando más de 400 personas murieron en un ataque aéreo pakistaní sobre Kabul, que, según los talibanes afganos, alcanzó un centro de rehabilitación de drogadictos. Islamabad negó la acusación, afirmando que "se dirigió específicamente contra instalaciones militares e infraestructuras de apoyo a los terroristas".

item.title: El IBEX 35 abre a la baja ante el resurgir de los nervios en el mercado de deuda
item.description: El IBEX 35 abrió a la baja el jueves, en una jornada marcada por el regreso de los nervios al mercado de deuda, con unas rentabilidades de los bonos que han escalado a máximos de varios años a medida que los inversores descuentan nuevas subidas de tipos de los bancos centrales para contener la inflación.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El IBEX 35 abrió a la baja el jueves, en una jornada marcada por el regreso de los nervios al mercado de deuda, con unas rentabilidades de los bonos que han escalado a máximos de varios años a medida que los inversores descuentan nuevas subidas de tipos de los bancos centrales para contener la inflación. La rentabilidad del bono estadounidense a diez años avanzaba 1,1 puntos básicos, hasta el 5,125%, después de tocar en la víspera su nivel más alto desde 2007, lo que pesaba sobre las bolsas. Los inversores mantenían la vista puesta en una batería de discursos de banqueros centrales y en varias referencias económicas, entre ellas las peticiones semanales de subsidio por desempleo en Estados Unidos, en busca de señales sobre la trayectoria de las tasas de interés. El tono de las autoridades monetarias seguía siendo restrictivo mientras el encarecimiento del petróleo alimentaba las presiones inflacionistas. El gobernador de la Reserva Federal Michael Barr afirmó el miércoles que la reciente subida de tasas del banco central formaba parte de sus esfuerzos por recalibrar el coste de financiación y apuntó a que [USN:L6N45F0SK TEXT:"podrían ser necesarios nuevos incrementos"]. El mercado aguardaba las intervenciones de otros responsables de la Fed a lo largo del jueves, incluidos el presidente de la Reserva Federal de Nueva York, John Williams, y la presidenta de la de Cleveland, Beth Hammack. En paralelo, la atención se dirigía a la cumbre entre el presidente estadounidense, Donald Trump, y el chino, Xi Jinping, con la esperanza de avances en las relaciones comerciales. El primer [USN:L6N45G0AR TEXT:"viaje de Xi a Estados Unidos"] en casi tres años no auguraba grandes acuerdos, pero Washington y Pekín [USN:L6N45G0BN TEXT:"acordaron prorrogar la tregua comercial"] vigente desde hace once meses. Las tensiones geopolíticas, en todo caso, mantenían elevados los precios de la energía. Responsables iraníes se comunicaron con enviados estadounidenses en la Asamblea General de la ONU, aunque ambas partes dieron [USN:L1N45F0XA TEXT:"pocas señales de progreso"] hacia el fin del conflicto. Trump reiteró sus amenazas de una mayor escalada, mientras el presidente iraní prometía no ceder: el líder de Teherán aseguró que no se rendirá jamás después de que Trump advirtiera de que podría "aniquilar" a Irán. Con todo, los precios del crudo [USN:L6N45G0AH TEXT:"cedían terreno"] mientras los operadores hacían una pausa para reevaluar los riesgos de suministro ligados al conflicto bélico. "Los inversores siguen mostrando cautela ante la evolución de los bonos y del petróleo", explican los analistas de Bankinter en su comentario previo a la apertura de las bolsas europeas. "En ausencia del catalizador que han proporcionado recientemente los positivos resultados empresariales será difícil que mejore el tono. Solo eventuales anuncios favorables derivados de la reunión entre Trump y Xi Jinping podrían animar la sesión", añaden. En la renta variable española, el selectivo bursátil español IBEX 35 (.IBEX) caía 118,00 puntos, un 0,60%, hasta 19.514,20 puntos, a las 0700 GMT del jueves, mientras que el índice de grandes valores europeos FTSE Eurofirst 300 (.FTEU3) retrocedía un 0,29%. En el sector bancario, Santander (SAN.MC) perdía un 1,22%, BBVA (BBVA.MC) retrocedía un 0,68%, Caixabank (CABK.MC) cedía un 1,37%, Sabadell (SABE.MC) ganaba un 0,11%, Bankinter (BKT.MC) se dejaba un 0,90% y Unicaja Banco (UNI.MC) perdía un 0,95%. Entre los grandes valores no financieros, Telefónica (TEF.MC) se anotaba un 0,47%, Inditex (ITX.MC) cedía un 0,53%, Iberdrola (IBE.MC) se dejaba un 0,20%, Cellnex (CLNX.MC) ganaba un 0,20% y la petrolera Repsol (REP.MC) subía un 0,72%. Pese al retroceso, el IBEX 35 se mantiene aún a escasa distancia de sus máximos históricos alcanzados el mes pasado —20.213,6 puntos el 11 de agosto, a precios de cierre, y 20.356,5 en niveles intradía el 13 de agosto—, por lo que algunos observadores consideran lógicas las tomas de beneficio ante el mínimo pretexto.

item.title: India's insurance overhaul: What changes and why it matters
item.description: India's insurance regulator has proposed capping what insurers pay banks, brokers and agents to sell policies, a move that could eventually make insurance cheaper for customers but squeeze distributors' incomes.
item.dc:creator: Ashwin Manikandan
item.content:encoded: India's insurance regulator has [USN:L4N45F16M TEXT:"proposed"] capping what insurers pay banks, brokers and agents to sell policies, a move that could eventually make insurance cheaper for customers but squeeze distributors' incomes. The proposed norms introduced in a discussion paper, issued late on Wednesday, are part of the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India's broader effort to reform the sector after New Delhi opened it to 100% foreign ownership this year. Shares of insurance distributors and lenders with significant insurance income [USN:L4N45G0A1 TEXT:"fell"] on Thursday. The proposals are not final and could change based on the feedback the regulator receives before October 25. WHY IS THE IRDAI DOING THIS? Distributor compensation has risen faster than underlying business. Life insurers paid 608 billion rupees ($6.34 billion) in commissions in fiscal 2025, up 18%, while premium growth was just 6.73%, IRDAI data shows. India is the world's 10th-largest insurance market, yet insurance penetration remains low compared to the global average. The proposed changes are part of planned reforms as the IRDAI seeks to bring coverage closer to global levels. WHAT ARE THE BIG CHANGES? The IRDAI has proposed reintroducing commission caps across products, reversing its 2023 decision to scrap them. The regulator wants distributors to earn less for selling simple products and more for complex ones. Banks and brokers that represent multiple insurers would face commission caps at a lower level than agents tied to a single insurer. For life insurance, the IRDAI wants to reduce large upfront payouts and spread compensation over the life of a policy. For compulsory third-party motor insurance, no commission would be paid on new vehicles, while only limited payouts would be allowed on renewals for older vehicles. WHAT ARE THE NEW LIMITS? In the life insurance segment, commissions for banks and brokers could stand at 5% to 20% of the first-year premium, compared to the more-than-40% rates currently in play for several products. For health insurance, commissions would be capped at 15% in the first year and 5% on renewals, compared to the over-30% fee charged by distributors today. The IRDAI's proposal also says that third-party insurance on new vehicles would carry no commissions compared to current rates of around 25% to 50% in the motor insurance segment. Sales in small towns and rural areas would attract an additional 10% to 20%. WHAT DOES IT MEAN FOR CUSTOMERS? Commissions are embedded in premiums, according to the IRDAI, meaning lower distribution costs could eventually reduce prices. But there is no guarantee that insurers will pass on the savings. The proposals would also bar banks from making loans conditional on the purchase of insurance. If a bank offers a cheaper loan rate with insurance, it would have to disclose both rates and allow customers to buy cover from any insurer. The changes may also curb the sale of policies that customers later abandon. WHICH BUSINESSES WILL BE HIT MOST? Banks that distribute life insurance face the greatest pressure, while insurers depending on bank-linked sales could take a short-term hit. While the reforms are aimed at lowering policy costs and curbing mis-selling, analysts said they could disrupt existing distribution models, weighing on growth in an industry that relies heavily on channels such as agent and bancassurance — the sale of insurance through banks — for business. Dealer-linked motor brokers could also be affected. ($1 = 95.8850 Indian rupees)

item.title: US packaged food makers could help cut diet-related deaths, study shows
item.description: US packaged food companies could prevent around 150,000 diet-related deaths annually by moving sales towards healthier products in sectors including baked goods, savory snacks, cookies and candy, a study published on Thursday showed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US packaged food companies could prevent around 150,000 diet-related deaths annually by moving sales towards healthier products in sectors including baked goods, savory snacks, cookies and candy, a study published on Thursday showed. Here are some more details: Netherlands-based Access to Nutrition initiative and NGO ShareAction analysed nearly 10,000 packaged food and beverage products sold by 24 major manufacturers operating in the United States. The 24 companies account for an estimated 37% of the US packaged food and beverage market by sales value. The research found that around 150,000 deaths linked to diet-related diseases, such as cardiovascular disease and stroke, could be delayed in a single year if food and beverage companies shifted US sales towards healthier products already available on the market. Companies moving sales towards the healthiest half of products within each food category could substantially reduce healthcare costs and also prevent approximately US$11.6 billion in lost pay due to diet-related ill health, the study said. The largest opportunities for improvement were in baked goods, sauces, dips and condiments, confectionery, carbonated drinks and savory snacks, the study said. The study noted that healthier options already exist across these categories, meaning that many benefits could be achieved through portfolio shifts and product reformulation.

item.title: YouTube dice que sus nuevas herramientas de IA ayudarán a los creadores, no los reemplazarán
item.description: La plataforma anunció nuevas funciones de inteligencia artificial para edición, moderación, traducción y recomendaciones de productos, con el objetivo de facilitar el trabajo de los creadores.
item.dc:creator: Alex, ra S. Levine
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — YouTube anunció este miércoles una serie de actualizaciones de productos destinadas a mostrar sus últimas capacidades en materia de inteligencia artificial, al tiempo que trataba de disipar las preocupaciones de que esta tecnología pudiera dejar obsoletos a los creadores. El mensaje transmitido en el evento anual “Made on YouTube”, celebrado en Nueva York, fue claro: el creciente conjunto de herramientas de inteligencia artificial del gigante del vídeo, que se basa en los modelos más potentes de su empresa matriz, Google, tiene como objetivo aligerar la carga de trabajo de los creadores en materia de edición, producción y tareas administrativas. Según la empresa, no pretenden sustituir a las personas ni a su proceso creativo. Ver más: Google se suma a OpenAI, Anthropic y Meta al revelar hackeos de sistemas de IA Y aunque los directivos reconocieron el auge de la IA ‘agente’, una tecnología que permite a los agentes virtuales asumir tareas más propias de los humanos, hicieron hincapié en que el objetivo de YouTube es liberar a los creadores de las tareas tediosas y rutinarias para que puedan centrarse en la narración de historias. “No son más que herramientas”, afirmó el miércoles Aparna Pappu, vicepresidenta de YouTube encargada de la creación, en una mesa redonda. “En última instancia, lo que más importa es la voz del creador”. Este mensaje subraya la delicada línea que YouTube debe seguir en la era de la IA. La empresa se ha convertido en el mayor servicio de vídeo del mundo gracias al aprovechamiento del contenido generado por los usuarios. Al mismo tiempo, Google, perteneciente a Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ), es un motor clave de la revolución de la IA que está transformando los medios de comunicación y el entretenimiento. Amjad Hanif, responsable del equipo de productos para creadores de YouTube, se hizo eco de la idea de que los seres humanos siguen teniendo el control. “Las herramientas de IA solo facilitan algunas partes del proceso”, señaló Hanif. “En realidad, no generan un contenido mejor ni una mejor conexión con su público”. Ver más: YouTube incorpora a Amazon a su programa de compras para competir con TikTok Shop La empresa lleva varios años perfeccionando su oferta de inteligencia artificial para creadores, y muchas de las últimas funciones están pensadas para YouTube Shorts, los vídeos de formato corto que compiten con TikTok y con Instagram Reels, de Meta Platforms Inc ( META ). Aunque cada día se suben más de 20 millones de vídeos a YouTube y sigue siendo la plataforma más lucrativa para los creadores, con los ingresos publicitarios más elevados del sector, la competencia es cada vez más feroz. Algunas de las nuevas ofertas de IA de YouTube tienen como objetivo facilitar a los YouTubers más pequeños o con menos experiencia la creación de contenido, la captación de audiencia y el desarrollo de un negocio sostenible. A principios de 2027, por ejemplo, se integrará en YouTube Shorts y en la aplicación de edición YouTube Create un nuevo “asistente de edición conversacional” desarrollado con la tecnología de IA Gemini de Google. Este actuará como un “socio creativo” colaborativo, ofreciendo ayuda recíproca durante dicho proceso, según ha indicado la empresa. Ver más: La IA compite cada vez más con los gobiernos por el capital: BlackRock ve US$7,5 billones en juego “Muchas de estas herramientas le permiten hacer cosas que quizá antes no estuvieran a su alcance”, afirmó Pappu refiriéndose a los creadores más pequeños. Otras actualizaciones relacionadas con la IA presentadas el miércoles estaban más orientadas a los YouTubers consolidados. La plataforma está probando una moderación de contenidos personalizada mediante IA que los creadores pueden utilizar para gestionar su sección de comentarios, por ejemplo. YouTube también está ampliando su herramienta de detección de imágenes, que permite a los creadores supervisar el sitio en busca de vídeos generados por IA que hagan un uso indebido de imágenes de sus rostros y solicitar su eliminación. Esta función incluirá, con el tiempo, protecciones relativas a las voces grabadas. Las retransmisiones en directo, un formato cada vez más popular, constituyen otra área clave de inversión para la empresa. A principios de 2027, YouTube ampliará su herramienta automática de ‘doblaje’ a YouTube Live, donde más del 40% del tiempo de visualización procede de espectadores internacionales. Esta herramienta utiliza la IA para traducir los vídeos de los creadores a otros idiomas en tiempo real, de modo que puedan llegar a un público aún más amplio. Además, la empresa está ofreciendo a los creadores más oportunidades de obtener ingresos a partir de sus publicaciones y de sus audiencias a nivel mundial. Esto incluye intensificar los esfuerzos en el ámbito del comercio electrónico con YouTube Shopping. Se trata del tipo de gran apuesta que el gigante del vídeo realizó con los podcasts, un ámbito en el que actualmente es el servicio más popular de EE.UU. YouTube también se había adentrado anteriormente en los salones de los hogares compitiendo con la televisión tradicional. Tras asociarse en agosto con Amazon.com Inc. ( AMZN ) como su nuevo socio afiliado más importante en EE.UU., YouTube amplió esa colaboración a la India y Brasil el miércoles. Además, la empresa tiene previsto ampliar su programa de afiliados a 35 países antes de que finalice el año. Los espectadores también podrán utilizar en breve una función de IA independiente, ‘ Ask YouTube ’, para solicitar a la plataforma recomendaciones de productos a partir de los vídeos de los creadores. “Nos preocupa profundamente que nuestros creadores tengan éxito, y si pueden ganarse la vida con ello, crearán más contenido y más personas dedicarán tiempo a verlo”, afirmó Travis Katz, director de YouTube Shopping, que utiliza la inteligencia artificial para ayudar a los creadores a etiquetar los productos que utilizan en sus vídeos y retransmisiones en directo, y a obtener comisiones por ellos. “Con Shopping y con los acuerdos con marcas, estamos muy comprometidos con ese futuro”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: Lifelong fan Alcaraz 'suffering' as Real Madrid off to a slow start
item.description: The tennis player endured a different kind of agony after Real Madrid's sputtering start.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: While Carlos Alcaraz may have finally left his persistent [USN:L4N44Q01H TEXT:"injury woes behind"], the Spanish tennis player is enduring a different kind of agony as a lifelong Real Madrid supporter watching his team's sputtering start to the season. Real, who were [USN:L6N45C064 TEXT:"beaten 2-1 by rivals Atletico Madrid"] on Sunday, are fourth in the standings with 15 points — 6 behind rivals and league leaders Barcelona. Asked about Real's performances under new manager Jose Mourinho, seven-time Grand Slam champion Alcaraz told Stats Perform on Wednesday that the club "can do better". "Right now, I'm seeing other teams doing better. They are Real Madrid, great players, talented," added the Spaniard, speaking ahead of the Laver Cup, where he will be part of Team Europe. "As a team, they can do better. They have to work it out a little bit. I'm suffering right now watching the games because you never know what's going to happen. I would say a little bit more intensity (is needed)." Alcaraz's Team Europe teammate Casper Ruud also weighed in on soccer, hailing Norwegian compatriot and Manchester City player Erling Haaland as the best striker in the world. "His ratio of touches to goals, I mean, no one can match him. No one is even near," the former world number two added. The three-day Laver Cup begins on Friday in London and will also feature Alexander Zverev, Flavio Cobolli, Jakub Mensik and Rafael Jodar for the Europeans. Andre Agassi's Team World features Taylor Fritz, Learner Tien, Brandon Nakashima, Alex de Minaur, Alexander Bublik and Francisco Cerundolo. Team Europe, captained by Yannick Noah, are attempting to reclaim the Laver Cup after last year's defeat by Team World in San Francisco.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
日経平均は4日続伸、米半導体株高を好感　金利上昇警戒で伸び悩む 16:03 配信

写真は2024年12月、東京証券取引所で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

[東京 ２４日 ロイター] - 東京株式市場で日経平均は４日続伸し、前営業日比０．７６％（４９５円０４銭）高の６万５５１３円９９銭で取引を終えた。大型連休中に米国株式市場で人工知能（ＡＩ）・半導体関連株が上昇したことを好感。日本株もその動きを受け、終始買い優勢となった。ただ、金利上昇に対する警戒感が強く、中盤から伸び悩む展開。ＴＯＰＩＸはマイナスで大引けた。

シルバーウイーク中の米株市場では、フィラデルフィア半導体指数（ＳＯＸ）が２３日こそ軟化したものの、連休前の１８日終値との比較で５．１％上昇となっており、日本の半導体関連株もこれに連動する形となった。

そうした中で、米長期金利が上昇基調を継続するとともに、国内の長期金利も上昇。利回りは一時３．０７５％と１９９６年８月以来３０年ぶりの高水準を更新した。金利上昇はＡＩ関連以外の、金利・為替動向が直接収益に結び付く業種の株価には逆風になるとの見方が出ている。

ただ、中間期末を控え、需給面では中間配当の権利取りを狙った動きが活発化するとみられ「配当取りが下支え要因となり、目先的に株価は大きく崩れるとは考えにくい」（国内証券ストラテジスト）という。

市場では「連休中の米株市場でＡＩ関連株が上昇したことが、日経平均を支える格好となったものの、全体的には金融政策に反応しやすい地合いが続いている。景気敏感株のみならず、金融株がさえない現況から、景気悪化の中で金利が上昇するスタグフレーションを市場は警戒していると言えそうだ」（野村証券・ストラテジストの秋山渉氏）との指摘もある。

ＴＯＰＩＸは０．３９％安の４０７５．３ポイントで取引を終えた。東証プライム市場指数は前営業日比０．３９％安の２１０２．４２ポイントだった。プライム市場の売買代金は９兆２０３８億８６００万円だった。

東証３３業種では、値上がりは海運や鉱業、保険など１６業種、値下がりはその他製品や精密機器、医薬品など１７業種。

キオクシアＨＬＤＧが横ばい。ソフトバンクグループが小高い。レーザーテックが堅調。オムロンが大幅高。キッコーマンが小安い。花王が小高い。

個別では、イビデン、アドバンテストなどが引き続き堅調だが、トヨタ自動車、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループが軟調となっている。

新興株式市場は、東証グロース市場２５０指数が小幅安となり、０．１％（０．７９ポイント）安の８０８．１９ポイントだった。

東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが６７４銘柄（４３％）、値下がりは８３８銘柄（５３％）、変わらずは４２銘柄（２％）だった。

item.title: China's rare earths dominance to overshadow Trump's talks with Xi
item.description: The US will remain reliant on China for rare earths well into the 2030s even as it rapidly builds its own mining and processing facilities, a stark imbalance facing President Donald Trump as he meets on Thursday with Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping.
item.dc:creator: Ernest Scheyder
item.content:encoded: The US will remain reliant on China for rare earths well into the 2030s even as it rapidly builds its own mining and processing facilities, a stark imbalance facing President Donald Trump as he meets on Thursday with Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping . Rare earths, which are among the [USN:L8N3XT0HP TEXT:"60 minerals considered critical by Washington"], must be processed before they are turned into magnets and other materials used to make weapons, automobiles, computers and myriad other goods. While US output of the two most-commonly used rare earths has more than tripled since Trump returned to office last year, the country can only meet 42% of its demand and within five years will still rely on imports for nearly a quarter of its demand, according to data from Benchmark Mineral Intelligence, a minerals consulting firm. China, the world's dominant rare earths miner and refiner, last year [USN:L4N45709Q TEXT:"agreed to delay restrictions"] on exports until November 10. A potential extension of those export delays is [USN:L1N4560MQ TEXT:"on the agenda"] for Xi and Trump when they meet in Washington. The White House had set its own [USN:L1N4340RC TEXT:"January 2027 deadline"] to block imports of Chinese rare earths, a goal that will be all but impossible to meet. "The goal isn't for the US to replace China as the dominant global supplier," said Coco Zhang, an analyst at ING. "The more realistic objective is to build a meaningful alternative supply chain that can protect strategic sectors during periods of geopolitical disruption." Trump has made rare earths a national security priority since returning to office, pouring billions of dollars into [USN:L4N3T70RF TEXT:"MP Materials"] (MP.N) , [USN:L1N3YP08K TEXT:"USA Rare Earth"] (USAR.O) , [USN:L4N42Q0UT TEXT:"Energy Fuels"] (UUUU.A) and others in an attempt to loosen China's grip. While those investments have started to bear fruit, the country's ongoing need for imports underscores Trump's weak bargaining position with Xi and the broader [USN:KBN2ZD0N4 TEXT:"complexity of creating a rare earths industry from scratch"] after the US all but abandoned the sector in the late 20th century. "We have to build this properly with urgency," said Kunal Sinha, founder of [USN:L6N3UR01X TEXT:"minerals processing startup Valor"]. "And when we build this up, we will be able to meet that demand." Additionally, the US processes hardly any of the so-called [USN:L4N43M09P TEXT:"heavy rare earths"] used in military applications, although its output of those hyper-specialized minerals should rise by 2031 even as it falls short of demand, according to the Benchmark data. CHINA DOMINATES PROCESSING [USN:L1N3BJ1PW TEXT:"Rare earths processing"] has proved complex for the US to master given the chemical and mechanical difficulties of separating the 17 rare earths from each other. "Western countries are in a stronger position to reduce their reliance on China, but replacing Chinese supply across the full value chain is much more difficult," said Todd Downing, a minerals analyst with consultancy Project Blue. To be sure, US rare earths companies are growing. MP Materials, for instance, earlier this month began delivering magnets made from its own refined rare earths to General Motors (GM.N) as part of a [USN:L1N2SU176 TEXT:"deal inked in 2021"]. USA Rare Earth has been an [USN:L8N43P1CG TEXT:"acquisition spree"] this year after US government investment, buying a Brazilian mine and a French processing plant. Energy Fuels (UUUU.A) earlier this year agreed to buy a company that had built a major [USN:L4N42V0QJ TEXT:"magnet facility"] in South Carolina. "Rare earths domestic onshoring is moving forward," said Tim Moore, a rare earths analyst with financial services firm Clear Street. "It's early innings, but it's happening." Startups, including Nth Cycle, [USN:L1N3BJ1PW TEXT:"Ucore Rare Metals"] (UCU.V) and others, have been experimenting with new ways to refine rare earths. "The US continues to make a lot of rapid progress in developing our capacity to produce materials across the supply chain," said Albert Gore, head of ZETA, an electric vehicle trade group. The EV industry is a large user of rare earth magnets. Even still, some Chinese suppliers [USN:L6N44T09G TEXT:"have begun holding back shipments to the US"] due to fears of offending Beijing, Reuters reported earlier this month. That could pose a wider threat to US manufacturers if Xi opts to formally block exports. Ford Motor (F.N) last year, for example, [USN:L4N3SG1B9 TEXT:"temporarily shuttered US factories"] after supplies of Chinese rare earths dried up. "We are all working very hard to stand up the processing capacity as quickly as we can," said Megan O'Connor, CEO of Nth Cycle, which developed technology it says can process rare earths and earlier this week signed a [USN:L1N45E0PC TEXT:"$1 billion supply agreement with Glencore"].

item.title: Africa's cement boom signals next great shift in global energy use
item.description: Africa currently consumes under 5% of global energy supplies, and so is vastly overshadowed by other regions in assessments of current energy and pollution trends. But the region's aggressive cement plant construction plans may be about to change that.
item.dc:creator: Gavin Maguire
item.content:encoded: Africa currently consumes under 5% of global energy supplies, and so is vastly overshadowed by other regions in assessments of current energy and pollution trends. But the region's aggressive cement plant construction plans may be about to change that. African nations dominate the global pipeline for cement capacity under construction, accounting for 42% of all cement production capacity currently being built, data from Global Energy Monitor (GEM) shows. That construction share compares to an 8% share of currently operational cement capacity, signifying aggressive growth in planned cement production across the continent. But investments in cement capacity are about much more than construction raw materials. They are bets on urbanization, industrialization and broader regional economic development. Before countries consume larger volumes of steel, chemicals and manufactured goods, they generally consume vast quantities of concrete to build housing, roads, ports, factories and power infrastructure. In that sense, the cement pipeline acts as a leading indicator of Africa's broader energy needs, which look set to accelerate sharply if the expected construction boom tied to cement capacity plans emerges. In turn, any such African industrialization boom would likely contrast with trends in other regions, where electrification and slowing heavy industrial output are projected to curb energy and emissions trends in much of the rest of the world. LEANING IN Africa currently has around 441 million metric tons of annual cement production capacity in operation, and around 43.3 million tons of annual capacity under construction, GEM data shows. African nations have also announced plans for a further 23 million tons of annual capacity, which in combination would lift the region's total cement capacity by around 15% compared to current levels, to just over 507 million tons. That overall increase in cement capacity far exceeds planned cement capacity additions in all other regions, and indicates that Africa's development roadmap looks set to be more raw materials-intensive than many other parts of the world. Africa's heavy cement plans also indicate an equally steep climb in associated raw material and energy needs, as cement production is notoriously energy intensive and requires large volumes of coal, petroleum coke, natural gas and other fuels to ensure abundant output. As these cement projects come on line, they will also increase demand for electricity as well as the infrastructure needed to import, distribute and store coal, gas and other fuels, and also to ship out the concrete supplies produced. In other words, the plans to rapidly expand Africa's cement production footprint point to rising African demand for industrial energy, which in many African markets will likely be initially supplied by fossil fuels. FRONTRUNNERS EGYPT AND NIGERIA Among individual African nations, Egypt has the largest existing cement capacity footprint, of around 88 million tons per year. Nigeria has the largest pipeline for cement capacity under construction (10 million tons), and ranks second only to India in terms of cement capacity currently being built. Libya, Mali, Angola, Uganda, Mozambique and Cameroon also have cement construction pipelines that rank within the global top 20, highlighting that the growth swell is expected throughout the continent. The scale of planned cement construction suggests Africa's urbanization will still require large quantities of physical materials, even if the continent adopts cleaner energy technologies more quickly than previous industrializing regions. Indeed, the fact that 16 separate African nations are currently constructing new cement kilns seems to suggest Africa is on track to partly follow the same blueprints used by countries in Asia and elsewhere. CLEANER CONCRETE? One key distinction between Africa's cement plans and those followed previously by other regions is that African developers have the chance to underpin their cement facilities on the latest and most efficient components available. Modern kilns are notably more efficient than those installed 10 or more years ago, and so should be able to churn out greater volumes of cement with fewer overall inputs. Locally produced renewable energy — such as via rooftop solar installations — can also help run grinding and processing machines, and thereby reduce overall energy bills for producers. Electric cement kilns are also becoming more widely available, and so offer a potential path to even further reductions in energy intensity within countries keen on limiting the carbon footprint of industrial operations. However, cost considerations are likely to remain paramount in many African markets, which may slow adoption of more expensive emissions-reduction technologies such as carbon capture. That means that energy and materials-intensive cement operations will likely be the norm across Africa, even as they deploy the latest available kilns and components while they set up shop. All told, the cement projects scattered across Nigeria, Libya, Mali, Mozambique and elsewhere are not merely industrial investments. They represent early signs of where future energy demand growth may emerge. As Africa urbanizes and industrializes, the continent could become one of the world's most important sources of incremental demand for electricity, transport fuels and industrial energy, forcing policymakers to balance rising living standards against rising emissions. item.title: 米中首脳、貿易やAI巡り協議へ－台湾が取り上げられるか注視
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 中国の習近平国家主席がワシントンに到着した。訪米は約3年ぶりとなる。24日のトランプ米大統領との注目の首脳会談は、世界1、2位の経済大国を率いる2人が個人的な関係を深め、貿易やAI、イラン戦争、台湾の未来など対立を抱える問題で共通点を探る機会となる。

米国は、トランプ氏が大統領復帰後に始めた貿易戦争を巡り、米中両国は休戦措置を2カ月延長することで合意したと発表した。2025年10月に合意し、今年11月10日に期限を迎える予定だった休戦措置では、双方が相手国からの輸入品に課していた関税を引き下げ、中国産レアアース（希土類）などの製品輸出に対して計画されていた一部の輸出規制を停止した。

米中は貿易障壁をさらに引き下げる方法についても協議しており、首脳会談で追加合意に至る可能性がある。提案の一つは、エネルギーや農産物を含む一部の米国産品について、中国の関税を大幅に引き下げるものだ。

これは、貿易委員会の枠組みを通じ、双方がそれぞれ300億ドル（約4兆7500億円）相当の製品に対する輸入障壁を緩和する従来の取り組みに基づいている。中国からの一部品目には最恵国税率が適用される。

ただ、関税を巡る緊張緩和が実現する保証は全くない。中国政府は以前から米国の輸入関税に不満を表明している。

一方、米政府は他国の貿易慣行に対する調査を開始しており、米連邦最高裁が今年2月に無効とした「相互関税」に代わり、中国に新たな措置を課す選択肢を確保する可能性がある。実施する場合、新たな関税率は7.5%となり得る。米国は首脳会談が終わるまで正式発表を見送る見通しだ。

日本と韓国は、トランプ氏の貿易面での要求に応じるため、米国への大規模投資や米国産品の購入拡大を確約している。トランプ政権は中国にも同様の対応を求めている。

中国は2028年まで年間2500万トンの米国産大豆を購入するとの確約について着実に履行を進め、今年分は最近、目標の半分を超えた。一方、米国産農産物に少なくとも追加で170億ドルを支出する別の確約は、達成がより難しい状況だ。

item.title: 米株の利上げ後下落傾向、今回は軽微か ＦＲＢの「前のめり度」が鍵
item.description:
Lewis Krauskopf
［ニューヨーク ２４日 ロイター］ - データを見ると、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米株の利上げ後下落傾向、今回は軽微か　ＦＲＢの「前のめり度」が鍵 15:57 配信

写真は2026年9月16日、ニューヨーク証券取引所（NYSE）の取引フロアで撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon

Lewis Krauskopf

［ニューヨーク　２４日　ロイター］ - データを見ると、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げを開始すると米国株は軟調になる。先週の約３年ぶりの利上げを受けて、米株市場は同じパターンになるのか、投資家は、ＦＲＢがどの程度積極的に利上げを進めるかや、経済がどう反応するか注視している。

「最終的には、ＦＲＢの行動が経済成長や企業利益の成長に対する市場の見通しに影響するかどうかだ」とＵＢＳグローバル・ウェルス・マネジメントの米国株責任者、デービッド・レフコウィッツ氏は話す。市場では、ＦＲＢがどこまで利上げする必要があるのかが議論の的になると指摘しつつ、「ＦＲＢがそれほど大幅に利上げする必要があるとは考えていない」と述べた。

Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種は年初から１２％超上昇。２３日は最高値圏で推移した。堅調な企業利益が、中東紛争を受けた原油価格の急騰、債券利回りの上昇、ＦＲＢのタカ派姿勢への転換といったリスクを上回っている。

ただ、投資家は短期的な下落に備えている。ＬＰＬファイナンシャルが、ＦＲＢが１９９４年に会合結果の公表を始めて以降の２０２２年まで６回の利上げ局面を分析したところ、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００は利上げ開始から３カ月後に中央値で２．６％下落していた。

ＲＢＣキャピタル・マーケッツの米国株ストラテジー責任者、ロリ・カルバシナ氏によると、その６回のうち、２２年を除く５回で、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００の高値からの下落率は８─１４％、安値は利上げ後１─３．５カ月に付けた。カルバシナ氏は１８日付のリポートで「この新たな局面に入ったことで、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００が短期的に５─１０％程度の通常の調整局面を迎える可能性について、引き続き警戒している」と述べた。

＜２０２２年の株安の記憶＞

２２年３月開始の利上げサイクルは他とはやや異なる。同年、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００は高値から２５％下落し、最初の利上げから約７カ月後に安値を付け、最終的に弱気相場入りした。

今回はどうなのか。カルバシナ氏ら市場アナリストは、２２年と現在および他の利上げ局面との環境の違いを指摘する。２２年は積極的に利上げが進められ、景気後退への懸念があった。

今回の利上げ局面は、比較的短期かつ緩やかなものになると見込まれている。ＬＳＥＧのデータによると、２３日時点のフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利先物は、金利が１年強で約４．８％に達し、利上げ幅は合計約１％ポイントにとどまることを示唆する。

ジェフリーズの株式ストラテジスト、ジェーン・ギボンズ氏によると、１９８３年以降の利上げサイクルの期間は平均２年弱、利上げ幅は３２０ｂｐ。２２─２３年のサイクルは５２５ｂｐだった。

今回の利上げの道筋について、エドワード・ジョーンズの投資戦略責任者、モナ・マハジャン氏は、「成長や、おそらく労働市場の観点からもまだ吸収可能なサイクル中間の政策調整」との見方を示した。

＜株価は下落後、回復へ＞

過去の利上げサイクルでは、株価は当初下落した後、比較的速やかに回復している。ＬＰＬファイナンシャルによると、最初の利上げから１年後のＳ＆Ｐ５００は中央値で６．８％上昇。２０２２─２０２３年の局面を除く全ての局面で、１年後の指数は上昇していた。「歴史的に見て、利上げ局面の開始直後は株式市場がやや不安定になる。その後は落ち着きを取り戻し、経済成長と利益成長というファンダメンタルズに回帰する傾向がある」と同社のチーフ株式ストラテジスト、ジェフリー・ブックバインダー氏は語った。

金利上昇は、これまで顕在化していなかった経済の弱点をあぶり出したり、弱点を悪化させたりする可能性がある。１９９９─２０００年の利上げサイクルでは、開始から１年後時点で株価は上昇していたが、当時の利上げは、２０００年代初めにインターネット・バブルが崩壊した後の大幅な株安を悪化させた可能性があると投資家はみている。

今回の利上げ後の株価に関しては、利上げ前の動きが比較的小さかったため、下落幅も限定される可能性がある。フランクリン・テンプルトン・インスティテュートのチーフ投資ストラテジスト、ジェフ・シュルツェ氏によると、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００は先週の利上げ前３カ月間、ほぼ横ばいで推移した。過去の最初の利上げ前３カ月間には平均４．２％上昇していた。「市場は季節的に非常に強い第４・四半期に向けて、緩やかな上昇を続ける態勢にあると考えている」とシュルツェ氏は述べた。

ＵＢＳのレフコウィッツ氏は、利上げサイクルが株式市場に及ぼす影響を見極める経済指標として、特にＩＳＭ製造業景況指数の新規受注指数を注視する方針だ。「市場は成長とインフレの両方のデータに、はるかに敏感になる」と語った。

item.title: India's Adani Group to invest $10.4 billion in West Bengal
item.description: India's Adani Group will invest 1 trillion rupees ($10.43 billion) in West Bengal by 2035, Chairman Gautam Adani said on Thursday, expanding its presence across sectors ranging from power generation and logistics to data centers.
item.dc:creator: Abhinav Parmar, Kashish Tandon
item.content:encoded: India's Adani Group will invest 1 trillion rupees ($10.43 billion) in West Bengal by 2035, Chairman Gautam Adani said on Thursday, expanding its presence across sectors ranging from power generation and logistics to data centers. The announcement underscores the ports-to-power conglomerate's push to diversify beyond its core infrastructure businesses, with growing investments in data centers, healthcare and clean energy alongside its ports, logistics and power operations. The investment will also support the development of roads, bridges and ropeways across the eastern state, Adani said. Speaking at the foundation stone-laying ceremony of a 2,000-bed hospital in the New Town area near Kolkata, West Bengal, Adani said the group would invest 40 billion rupees in the hospital, a medical college and a research facility. The project is expected to create more than 10,000 jobs across the state's healthcare ecosystem. ($1 = 95.8850 Indian rupees)

item.title: イスラエル首相、国連で「選挙演説」か ＮＹ市長を非難へ
item.description:
Alexander Cornwell Emily Rose
[テルアビブ ２４日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alexander Cornwell　Emily Rose

[テルアビブ ２４日 ロイター] - イスラエルのネタニヤフ首相は２４日の国連演説で、自身を「戦争犯罪人」と呼んだ米ニューヨーク市のマムダニ市長を激しく非難するとみられている。

今週のビデオ声明で市長に直接語りかけたネタニヤフ氏は、ニューヨークへは「われわれの英雄的な兵士たちについての真実を伝えるため」、そして「あなたについての真実を伝えるため」に行くと説明。マムダニ氏がイスラム組織ハマスを支援していると虚偽の非難を浴びせた。

マムダニ氏は、ネタニヤフ氏がニューヨークを訪れた場合、戦争犯罪の容疑で逮捕すると公約して選挙運動を行ったが、後になって、それを行う法的権限がないと判断したと述べた。今週には、ネタニヤフ氏を「パレスチナ人に対する恐ろしいジェノサイド（大量虐殺）の首謀者」と表現した。

戦争犯罪の容疑を否定しているネタニヤフ氏は、マムダニ氏が１月に市長に就任して以来初めてニューヨークを訪問することになる。ネタニヤフ氏の右派政権に反対するイスラエル人たちは、ニューヨークで抗議活動を行う計画だ。

世論調査によると、５週間後に迫ったイスラエル総選挙で、ネタニヤフ氏の長期にわたる政権が終焉（しゅうえん）を迎える可能性がある。

元イスラエル大使のマイケル・オレン氏は「彼は実際には国連に向けてではなく、イスラエル国民に向けて話すだろう」と述べ、ネタニヤフ氏の国連演説は「選挙演説」のようになると予想した。

ネタニヤフ氏は異例の短い日程で米国を訪問。２４日の早い時間帯に到着した後、午後に演説を終えると同日中に帰国する見込みで、トランプ米大統領との会談も見込まれていない。

item.title: 午後3時のドルは158円前半でほぼ横ばい、方向感欠く 米ＰＭＩ後の買いは一巡
item.description:
Atsuko Aoyama
[東京 ２４日 ロイター] -
ド...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午後3時のドルは158円前半でほぼ横ばい、方向感欠く　米ＰＭＩ後の買いは一巡 15:43 配信

写真は米ドル紙幣。2022年7月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Atsuko Aoyama

[東京 ２４日 ロイター] -

ドル／円 ユーロ／ドル ユーロ／円

午後３時現在 158.21／158.23 1.1375／1.1377 180.01／180.02

午前９時現在 158.25／158.29 1.1381／1.1383 180.14／180.15

ＮＹ午後５時 158.29／158.32 1.1382／1.1385 180.23／180.26

午後３時のドル／円は前日ニューヨーク市場終盤に比べてほぼ横ばいの１５８円前半で推移している。米総合購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ） 後の買いが一巡。実需勢などの売りで１５７円台に下落した後、再び１５８円台に切り返し、方向感に乏しい値動きとなった。

午前中はドル売りが優勢で推移し、実需勢の売りなどで１５７円後半に下落。その後は１５７円後半と１５８円近辺を上下する値動きとなった。足元では１５８円前半でドル買い／円売りが強まっている。

前週末の日銀の金融政策決定会合後にドルが１５８円を付けた後、日銀のレートチェックが実施されたことで為替介入への警戒感もくすぶり「上値は試しづらい」（国内銀行のストラテジスト）との声が聞かれた。

今後のドル／円相場に関して、オーストラリア・ニュージーランド銀行（ＡＮＺ）外国為替・コモディティ営業部の町田広之ディレクターは、前日の米ＰＭＩのように、１月まで２回織り込まれる米国の利上げ観測を「正当化するだけの強い経済指標が出続けるかは疑問」との見方を示す。米国では来週以降、重要指標の発表が相次ぐ予定となっている。

一方、日銀の金融政策スタンスを巡って、インフレの抑制に強い姿勢で臨む米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）や豪中銀などと比べてタカ派度合いが薄いとの見方は少なくないが、町田氏は政策の局面変化に言及した植田和男総裁は「基調物価が下期に２％を超えてくるという確信を持った言い方で、ビハインド・ザ・カーブ懸念は消え、円売りも限定的」とも指摘する。

item.title: Indonesia parliamentary panel approves 2027 budget with deficit at 2.4% of GDP
item.description: The Indonesian parliament's budget committee on Thursday approved total government spending of 4,106.3 trillion rupiah ($231 billion) in the 2027 budget, with the fiscal deficit forecast at 2.40% of GDP, the committee chair said.
item.dc:creator: Stefanno Sulaiman
item.content:encoded: The Indonesian parliament's budget committee on Thursday approved total government spending of 4,106.3 trillion rupiah ($231 billion) in the 2027 budget, with the fiscal deficit forecast at 2.40% of GDP, the committee chair said. The committee also approved a state revenue target of 3,435.1 trillion rupiah, chair Said Abdullah said. Both spending and revenue were 9.1 trillion rupiah higher than the initial [USN:L6N44B0KW TEXT:"budget proposal"] presented to parliament by President Prabowo Subianto in August. The higher spending was due to an increase in allocations for ministries and agencies, the committee chair said, with the revenue target raised by the same amount to keep the fiscal deficit unchanged. INVESTORS WORRIED BY SPENDING PLANS Investors have been closely watching Prabowo's spending plans amid concerns about their impact on fiscal discipline and debt levels. The budget worries have been one of the factors weighing on the rupiah this year, which hit a record low against the dollar in June. The rise of global oil prices in recent weeks has added to concerns about the fiscal outlook, renewing pressure on the currency. The forecast cost of energy subsidies in the approved budget was lowered by 11 trillion rupiah from the initial proposal to 261.5 trillion rupiah, or just over 6% of total spending, because of improvements in fuel distribution. In other changes from the initial proposal, spending for defence has increased by 6 trillion rupiah to 335 trillion rupiah, around 8% of total spending, and the central government's education spending has increased by 14 trillion rupiah to 497 trillion rupiah, around 12% of total spending. At 2.4% of GDP, the forecast deficit is lower than the 2.85% gap expected for this year. Indonesia has a legislated deficit ceiling set at 3% of GDP. The budget has planned net bond issuance of 834 trillion rupiah, some 54 trillion rupiah higher than the initial proposal. The committee's decision is expected to receive approval in a broader parliamentary vote on September 29. HIGHER REVENUES FROM COMMODITIES Most economic assumptions for 2027 remained unchanged, with GDP growth targeted at 6%, inflation projected at 2.5%, and the rupiah assumed to average 17,500 per US dollar, the committee chair said. The projection for Indonesia's crude oil output was raised slightly, which partly explained the higher revenue target. Prabowo plans to boost revenue through [USN:L1N44B00Z TEXT:"greater proceeds"] from Indonesia's natural resources, supported by a planned [USN:L1N457094 TEXT:"commodity exchange"] to set prices and a new state export firm that will [USN:L4N42K0KR TEXT:"monitor key shipments"]. The 6% growth target tracks this year's goal, though some analysts said a growth rate of around 5% is more likely in 2026 given weaker spending and soft external demand. A draft bill accompanying the budget included a plan to charge an excise tax on sugary drinks. Finance Minister Suahasil Nazara, speaking to reporters after a hearing with the committee, declined to provide details. [USN:L1N45606D TEXT:"Suahasil"] was appointed as finance minister last week, after serving as deputy minister since 2019. ($1 = 17,795 rupiah)

item.title: ブラジル大統領選、ルラ氏・ボルソナロ氏の競り合い続く＝調査
item.description: [サンパウロ ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[サンパウロ ２３日 ロイター] - アトラスインテル／ブルームバーグが２３日に公表した世論調査によると、来月のブラジル大統領選で決選投票を想定した場合、左派現職のルラ大統領とボルソナロ前大統領の長男であるフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員の支持率が引き続き拮抗しており、誤差の範囲ながらルラ氏がわずかにリードしている。

・調査によると、決選投票ではルラ氏の支持率が４７．７％で、右派ボルソナロ氏の４７．４％を上回った。

・１７日公表の調査では、ボルソナロ氏がルラ氏を４７．２％対４６．８％でリードしていた。

・第１回投票を想定したシナリオでは、ルラ氏の支持率が４５．８％、ボルソナロ氏が４３．４％、レナン・サントス氏が４．５％、アウグスト・クリー氏が２．１％、ロナウド・カイアド氏が１．３％と続いた。

・前回調査では、第１回投票でルラ氏が４４．１％、ボルソナロ氏が４１．７％だった。

・１０月４日の選挙で有効票の５０％超を獲得する候補がいなければ、上位２候補が１０月２５日の決選投票に進む。

・調査は１７─２２日に５０１５人を対象に実施。誤差はプラスマイナス１％ポイント。

item.title: China's DeepSeek annualised revenue run rate hits $1 billion, the Information reports
item.description: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek's annualised revenue run rate has hit $1 billion, more than double from a few months ago, the Information reported on Thursday, citing two people with direct knowledge of the matter.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek's annualised revenue run rate has hit $1 billion, more than double from a few months ago, the Information reported on Thursday, citing two people with direct knowledge of the matter. Run-rate revenue shows how much a company would make in a year if it continued performing at its current pace. The figure underscores the rapid growth of the AI company that shook the tech industry last year after its models challenged US assumptions about China's AI capabilities. The company is [USN:L4N4500M5 TEXT:"planning to go public"] soon to fund its expansion. CEO Liang Wenfeng shared the latest revenue figure at a recent meeting with investors, as the company pushes ahead with a second funding round targeting 50 billion yuan ($7.45 billion) at a valuation of 500 billion yuan by the end of October, the Information reported. DeepSeek is also preparing for a potential listing on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, it added. DeepSeek's revenue growth was partly driven by raising model pricing by 2.3 to 4.5 times, the news outlet said. Reuters could not immediately verify the report. DeepSeek could not be immediately reached for comment. DeepSeek had hired CITIC Securities to prepare for a potential STAR Market IPO, though the timing, valuation and fundraising size remain undecided, Reuters reported this [USN:L6N43K020 TEXT:"month."] The AI firm continues to devote the bulk of its resources to developing new models, allocating more than 70% of its computing capacity to training while reserving less than 30% for inference, or running existing models, Liang told investors, the Information added. Earlier this month, the [USN:P8N42U0CJ TEXT:"company"] released its latest model, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, and said it is designed for greater capability, faster inference, higher throughput and scaling to larger models. ($1 = 6.7131 Chinese yuan renminbi) ($1 = 6.7113 Chinese yuan renminbi) (This story has been corrected to say that the company will raise money via a fundraise, not an IPO, in paragraph 4.)

item.title: インタビュー：日銀は3カ月ごと利上げ、政策金利は来年6月に2％へ＝桜井元日銀委員
item.description:
Takahiko Wada Leika Kihara
［東京 ２４日 ロイター］ - 元日銀審議委員の桜井真氏は２４日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インタビュー：日銀は3カ月ごと利上げ、政策金利は来年6月に2％へ＝桜井元日銀委員 15:30 配信

写真は元日銀審議委員の桜井真氏。2016年9月、都内の日本銀行本店で撮影。REUTERS/Toru Hanai

Takahiko Wada　Leika Kihara

［東京　２４日　ロイター］ - 元日銀審議委員の桜井真氏は２４日、ロイターのインタビューに応じ、日銀は今後も３カ月ごとに利上げして来年６月には政策金利が２％に到達するとの見通しを示した。中東情勢の緊迫化を受けて原油の調達コストが大幅に上昇しており、企業の価格転嫁が進むことで消費者物価の総合指数（総合ＣＰＩ）は年末から年度末にかけて３％を超える可能性が高いとみている。

＜政策運営上の「大きな転換点」＞

日銀は９月１７―１８日の金融政策決定会合で政策金利を１．２５％に引き上げることを決めた。２０２４年３月の異次元緩和の終了以降では最短となる３カ月での追加利上げとなった。桜井氏は日銀がインフレ対応にかじを切ったとして、金融政策運営上の「大きな転換点だ」と述べた。

桜井氏は、中東情勢の緊迫化で企業が代替調達を進めた結果、原油の輸入価格が大幅に上昇し、これが先行きの大きな物価上昇圧力になると警戒している。原油の輸入価格は米国とイスラエルによるイランへの軍事攻撃前に比べて７―８割上昇した。全国ＣＰＩで８月の総合指数は前年比１．９％上昇だが、桜井氏は年末から年度末にかけて３％を超える可能性が「十分にある」とみている。

桜井氏は、日銀が１０月の展望リポートで２６年度、２７年度ともに物価見通しを引き上げると予想する。追加利上げのタイミングは１２月を基本とするものの、展望リポートで物価予想の「修正幅が相当大きければ、１０月利上げの可能性もある」と述べた。

日銀は今後も３カ月ごとに０．２５％ずつ利上げしていき、来年６月には政策金利が２％に達すると予想している。現状はまだ実質金利がマイナスのため、問題は「２％に到達した後、どのくらいまで行けるか」だと指摘。「物価上昇率が３％になれば、本来的には２．５％まで行く可能性もある」とした。

今回の利上げを巡っては、ベセント米財務長官が日銀の金融政策に連日言及したことで市場が９月会合での利上げをほぼ完全に織り込む異例の展開をたどった。桜井氏は今回の利上げ判断について「ベセント米財務長官に助けられていることは否めない」と述べた。

＜利上げ加速でも円相場への影響は限定的＞

日銀が１８日の決定会合で利上げを決めると、外為市場は円売りで反応した。しかし、関係者によると、連休前に介入の準備段階として為替水準を尋ねるレートチェックが実施され、ドル／円は一時１５６円後半に急落した。

外為市場では、２人の審議委員が利上げに反対したことが「ハト派的な利上げ」と受け止められて円安の一因となったが、桜井氏は、２人の反対は日銀の政策判断への「影響はない」とする。むしろ、高市政権の拡張的な財政政策が変わらない限り「円高には振れにくい」と話す。「日銀が利上げをこれから加速していっても、円安を止めるだけの効果しか見込めないだろう」と述べ、為替介入を実施しても円高に振れるのは一時的で、すぐにドル／円は１６０円程度まで戻るとみている。

桜井氏は、今の日本は「輸出主導型の成長になっている」とみる。輸入インフレが起きても、企業は価格転嫁して収益を上げることができることに加え、円安が名目国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）に占める輸出額の比率を押し上げている。法人税収が高い伸びを示しており、高市政権の財政は「インフレと円安に支えられている」とも述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：日米金融政策の転換とドル／円の行方＝植野大作氏 コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も アングル：日銀、緩和的な金融環境継続に警戒　「機動対応」の局面続く コラム：マイナス金利解除後の円高を阻む高い壁＝内田稔氏 コラム：漸進的な日銀の緩和修正、ドル130円割れは短期間か＝植野大作氏 最終更新: 9/24(木) 15:30 ロイター

item.title: China's high-speed race for fast-charging EVs
item.description: Chinese EV makers have another battleground in their quest for technological supremacy: ultra-fast charging.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Chinese EV makers have another battleground in their quest for technological supremacy: ultra-fast charging. No longer satisfied with 30-minute top-ups, automakers such as Geely, BYD, and Li Auto are now racing to deliver charging speeds that mimic the 5-minute gasoline stop. That sprint to deliver extreme charging speeds has intensified as manufacturers seek to ease consumer range anxiety — and rekindle demand in the world's biggest car market, where growth has slowed. But pushing megawatt-level currents into lithium-ion batteries also poses severe engineering challenges, highlighting the risk of fire, battery degradation, and even the potential collapse of power grids. HOW FAST IS FAST? Chinese carmakers have raced ahead of Western rivals in charging capabilities. Geely (0175.HK) on Wednesday [USN:L4N45E0BT TEXT:"unveiled an ultra-fast charging"] setup that boasts a specialised battery and peak output of up to 2.25 megawatts (MW) from a single charging gun. Geely said the system can charge an EV from 10% to 70% in 4.5 minutes, and from 10% to 97% in 8 minutes and 40 seconds at room temperature. Rival BYD (002594.SZ) has developed its [USN:L1N4130EC TEXT:"own megawatt-level flash-charging systems"] and blade batteries capable of charging from 10% to 97% in 9 minutes. Li Auto's flagship electric vehicles are equipped with CATL's 5C Kirin battery, which can add up to 500 km (310 miles) of range in just 12 minutes. Battery maker Sunwoda (300207.SZ) joined the flash-charging race earlier this month with a battery system promising 10%-97% in 9 minutes. A standard 10% to 80% charge on a Tesla Supercharger usually requires 15 to 25 minutes, roughly double the time claimed by the latest Chinese systems. Mercedes-Benz offers fast charging from 10% to 80% in as quickly as 22 minutes. WHAT ARE FIRE AND SAFETY RISKS? A major hurdle in ultra-fast charging is managing intense heat and battery degradation. Rather than slowing charging speeds, Chinese carmakers are turning to advanced hardware engineering and artificial intelligence to keep batteries stable. To prevent hotspots, Geely introduced a full-loop "five-end" liquid cooling network that circulates fluid through the charging station's storage batteries, liquid-cooled cables, and to vehicle charging ports. Automakers are making certain EV battery cells shorter or adopting "short-blade" designs with less friction to keep the battery from overheating during mega-fast charging. Software is playing a role to address safety risks. Geely is deploying an AI technology with deep-learning algorithms running directly on the vehicle so it can anticipate temperature rises 30 seconds in advance. To combat battery wear from fast charging, automakers and battery manufacturers use different methods such as specialized coatings or high-frequency pulse currents. WHAT LIES AHEAD? Despite the rapid technological advancements, charging speeds are already hitting a ceiling, one Geely executive told Reuters. He hinted at moving from speed competition to massive infrastructure installations to accelerate roll out of fast charging networks. To prevent power grids from collapsing under multi-megawatt charging demands, fast-charging stations are integrated with battery storage systems and solar power. BYD plans to build 90,000 flash-charging stations by 2028 and install 300 of those over the next year in the UK. Smaller rival NIO (9866.HK) has over 4,000 battery-swap stations where a full battery replacement takes about three minutes.

item.title: Dictators, and why we can’t help forgiving them: Ruth Pollard
item.description: From Myanmar to Afghanistan, Belarus to Venezuela hostile regimes that were once shunned are now quietly being normalized, writes Ruth Pollard.
item.dc:creator: Ruth Pollard
item.content:encoded:
-->

Dictators, and why we can’t help forgiving them: Ruth Pollard

From Myanmar to Afghanistan, Belarus to Venezuela hostile regimes that were once shunned are now quietly being normalized, writes Ruth Pollard.

Ruth Pollard

24 September, 2026 11:56 am IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

File Photo | Taliban foreign minister Amir Khan Muttaqi during a roundtable discussion at FICCI in New Delhi | ThePrint/Suraj Singh Bisht

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

You may have missed it, but hostile regimes that were once shunned are now quietly being normalized. From Myanmar to Afghanistan, Belarus to Venezuela, military dictatorships, hardline Islamists and autocrats are edging their way back into the global order.

For some, that makes perfect sense. Governments naturally prioritize security and national interest, sanctions can be hit and miss, and businesses will pursue opportunities regardless of the optics. Yet there should be a cost for regaining a seat at the table.

Take the Taliban. Five years after it seized Kabul following the chaotic US military withdrawal, it has won a series of key diplomatic gains. Taliban-appointed diplomats now control missions across a growing number of countries including China and the United Arab Emirates, and it has signed economic and security agreements with neighbors. Has this recognition come at a cost? Not at all. The regime’s repressive nature, its ties with al-Qaeda and transnational terrorism, and its crushing treatment of women and girls all continue unabated.

Show Full Article

Aaron Zelin, a fellow at the Washington Institute for Near East Policy, calls it an “accreditation cascade” — through Gulf states, Turkey and Central Asia — where governments have accepted Taliban outreach without formally recognizing its rule. He notes in his analysis of five years of Taliban diplomacy that what began as meetings with a handful of nations has developed into joint commissions, trade councils and foreign missions. The regime is now making overtures to Washington on critical minerals.

On the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly this week, High Commissioner for Human Rights Volker Türk attended a meeting that implored the world to ensure that international engagement on Afghanistan was human-rights based and principled. The  governments that are cutting deals with Taliban representatives are doing anything but.

This doesn’t mean that isolating hostile regimes until they reform is the best way forward. The US has been negotiating with Belarus and easing sanctions in exchange for the release of political prisoners, while the UK is upgrading its diplomatic ties with Venezuela to support a democratic transition. And there are ways to engage without legitimizing states, or formally recognizing their governments. Representatives talk over technical and practical matters such as border movements and assistance during natural disasters. Germany, for example, explicitly says that while the Taliban hold “de facto power” it doesn’t recognize them as the legitimate government.

Nations in Asia should follow suit, particularly when it comes to dealing with Myanmar. It’s understandable that images of coup leader Min Aung Hlaing receiving an official welcome in regional capitals would cause despair among citizens, not to mention the National Unity Government that was formed by ousted lawmakers and other anti-junta figures.

Since the February 2021 coup, more than 100,000 people have been killed and 5.2 million displaced as fighting between the army and an array of ethnic militias and anti-junta groups tore the nation apart. Despite controlling as little as a quarter of the country, the military held widely condemned elections in December and January and started calling itself a government. Min Aung Hlaing was named president in April and soon embarked on a multi-nation diplomatic mission to China, Russia, Belarus, Thailand, Vietnam, Laos and Cambodia in a quest for legitimacy.

India was his first port of call. The countries share a 1,643-kilometer (1,021-mile) border, and New Delhi has every reason to communicate on issues from illegal weapons trade, drug trafficking and refugee movement. Yet it has gone far beyond that. Unlike the US and Europe, it has maintained ongoing diplomatic, military and economic contacts with the junta. On his three-day visit, Min Aung Hlaing and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi discussed critical minerals, trade and healthcare. It’s not clear whether Modi raised concerns about the discredited elections or the detention of Aung San Suu Kyi.

The Association of Southeast Asian Nation’s approach is no better. Asean is pushing a five-point consensus that aims to end the political and humanitarian crisis, while some member states are pursuing bilateral relations. It’s another clear lesson of what not to do. After denying the junta a seat at high-level meetings since 2021, Asean recently began testing that exclusion. To a chorus of criticism, foreign ministers held an informal meeting with their Myanmar counterpart in Bangkok in July.

Still, perhaps the gathering managed to extract a small price. The regime has since released photographs of Suu Kyi meeting an International Committee of the Red Cross representative, although it continues to reject Asean’s calls for her unconditional release and hasn’t allowed it access to her.

University of Stirling senior international politics lecturer Monalisa Adhikari has reviewed Myanmar’s outreach since the coup, tracking how the military-backed government projected normalcy through dealings with other states. She told me that nations should be clear about whether diplomatic actions constitute formal recognition or are simply technical contacts on practical issues. That would prevent the regime from portraying such engagement as an acknowledgement of its legitimacy.

When hostile regimes are allowed to reintegrate into the global order without reducing any of their abuses, it can undercut the leverage used to  resolve conflicts and strengthen their hold on power. Engagement isn’t the problem. Normalization without conditions is. If refusing every demand for change carries no lasting cost because relations are eventually restored anyway, why would anyone comply?

Ruth Pollard is a Bloomberg Opinion Managing Editor. Previously she was South and Southeast Asia government team leader at Bloomberg News and Middle East correspondent for the Sydney Morning Herald.

item.title: Ukraine-Attaque de missiles à Kyiv, deux morts
item.description: La Russie a frappé tôt jeudi la capitale ukrainienne Kyiv avec des missiles balistiques et des drones, faisant deux morts, dont l'un sur le parking d'une maternité, ont déclaré plusieurs responsables.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Russie a frappé tôt jeudi la capitale ukrainienne Kyiv avec des missiles balistiques et des drones, faisant deux morts, dont l'un sur le parking d'une maternité, ont déclaré plusieurs responsables. Six personnes ont également trouvé la mort lors d'une attaque russe contre une ferme dans un village de la région de Kharkiv (nord-est), a déclaré le gouverneur régional Oleh Syniehoubov sur l'application de messagerie Telegram, ajoutant que huit ouvriers agricoles avaient également été blessés. Ces derniers mois, la Russie a intensifié sa campagne aérienne contre l'Ukraine, déployant davantage de drones plus rapides et plus difficiles à intercepter, et profitant du manque d'intercepteurs dont souffre l'Ukraine pour abattre les missiles balistiques. "Alors que les gens dormaient, les éclairs des explosions illuminaient le ciel", a déclaré Volodimir Zelensky sur Telegram. "Une fois de plus, les principales cibles de leur frappe étaient Kyiv et les infrastructures civiles, des immeubles résidentiels, une maternité, les infrastructures énergétiques et la logistique." Le barrage nocturne a mobilisé un nombre non précisé de missiles hypersoniques et balistiques, 282 drones et d'autres engins, a déclaré l'armée de l'air ukrainienne. La Roumanie a déclaré qu'un drone s'était écrasé sur son territoire près de la frontière avec l'Ukraine, dans le comté de Suceava situé dans le nord-est du pays. Le ministère de la Défense a déclaré que des chasseurs F-16 avaient décollé à la suite de cette intrusion, sans préciser l'origine du drone. Le relâchement dans la pression exercée sur Moscou lui permet de lancer des frappes répétées, a déclaré Volodimir Zelensky, qui se trouvait à New York pour assister à une session de l'Assemblée générale de l'Onu. "À l'heure actuelle, les États-Unis ont la possibilité de réagir avec fermeté", a-t-il ajouté. "Nous avons besoin d'intercepteurs de missiles balistiques pour protéger des vies."

item.title: 米地裁、CNNなど報道3社のホワイトハウス立ち入り禁止を一時解除
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）： 米連邦判事は、トランプ政権に対し、CNN、MS
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米連邦判事は、トランプ政権に対し、CNN、MS NOW、ポリティコの記者に対するホワイトハウスへの立ち入り禁止措置を一時的に解除するよう命じた。

今回の判断は、報道各社にとって訴訟の序盤で有利な展開となった。CNNなどは訴訟で、トランプ大統領と政権高官が米憲法修正第1条で保障された権利を「直接攻撃」し、政権に関する報道への報復として違法に取材を制限したと主張している。

トランプ氏が指名したティモシー・J・ケリー連邦地裁判事が一時的な差し止め命令を出した。命令は2週間効力を維持する。ケリー判事によると、この間に仮差し止め命令を求める申し立てについて迅速に審理を進める。

ケリー判事は、報道機関側が訴訟の本案で勝訴する可能性が高いことを示す「高いハードル」を満たしたと判断。適正手続きの欠如や憲法上の自由の侵害、公共の利益を理由に挙げた。

また、政府側が主張する国家安全保障上の利益について「裏付けがほとんど示されていない」と指摘。トランプ氏自身も禁止措置を発表した際、各報道機関に「真実性が欠け、否定的だとされる点」に焦点を当てていたとした。

ケリー判事は「報道の自由の重要性を踏まえれば、原告と国民には、従前の状態を維持することに永続的な利益がある」とした。

トランプ氏は18日、CNNとMS NOW、ポリティコをホワイトハウスから締め出す方針を表明。SNSへの投稿で、政権に不利な報道を行っているとして、取材禁止措置を「即時適用」するとし、「他のフェイクニュース・メディアも後に続く」と述べていた。

ただ、報道各社によると、この決定について正式な通知を受けたのは、4日後に送付された書面だった。

裁判所に提出された書面では、CNN、MS NOW、ポリティコについて、「国家安全保障やその他の問題を巡り、検証可能な虚偽を流布し、機密情報を公表した」ことを理由に立ち入り禁止としたと説明していた。

item.title: UK homebuilder Vistry warns on profit, takes £470 million hit from strategic overhaul
item.description: Britain's largest affordable homebuilder Vistry on Thursday lowered its annual profit expectations and said it would take a £470 million ($622.51 million) hit from its strategic overhaul, including its exit from the South East of England.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's largest affordable homebuilder Vistry (VTYV.L) on Thursday lowered its annual profit expectations and said it would take a £470 million ($622.51 million) hit from its strategic overhaul, including its exit from the South East of England. Shares in Vistry, which have lost more than half of their value so far this year, dropped 7.7% in early trade on Thursday. Under the leadership of new CEO Adam Daniels, Vistry has been reshaping its portfolio, paring back its regional footprint and land acquisition targets, as it grapples with elevated construction and labour costs and a slowdown in sales. Vistry said it will exit private sales in the South East of England and focus on partner-funded construction in the region. The business has struggled with slow demand, and the broader South division drew scrutiny in recent years due to an [USN:L4N3ZY0M8 TEXT:"accounting issue"]. The company reduced fiscal 2026 adjusted profit before tax expectations to £165 million from a previous forecast of £200 million, excluding charges related to the restructuring and £40 million impact from delays in deals. Contract renegotiations as part of its turnaround efforts have also delayed the construction of new homes, it said. "Whilst the challenges we have experienced in the last couple of years have been exacerbated by market headwinds, the review has also made clear that our execution, regional discipline and capital allocation have not been consistent enough," said Daniels. Vistry expects fiscal 2027 adjusted pretax profit to be about £185 million, below analyst expectations of £199.26 million, based on LSEG data. "We are committed to entering 2027 on the right footing and following the actions taken, do not anticipate any need to raise equity," he said. Vistry said its banking group has provided waivers for its interest cover covenants for fiscal 2026 and the first half of fiscal 2027. The company swung to an adjusted loss before tax of £83.3 million for the six months ended June 30. ($1 = 0.7550 pounds)

item.title: 米、西岸入植地からの輸入禁止巡り対英批判声明案 公表に至らず
item.description:
Humeyra Pamuk Alexander Cornwell
[ワシントン／エルサレム ２３日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Humeyra Pamuk　Alexander Cornwell

[ワシントン／エルサレム ２３日 ロイター] - 米当局者が９月上旬、占領下のヨルダン川西岸にあるイスラエルの入植地からの輸入を阻止しようとする英国、フランス、カナダの計画を批判するルビオ国務長官名義の声明案を作成していたことが分かった。

８日付のこの文書はこれまで報じられていない。関係筋２人によると、ハッカビー駐イスラエル米大使の有力な側近であるデビッド・ミルスタイン氏が主導したもので、ロイターが確認したこの声明案には「（各国の措置は）反ユダヤ主義的なボイコット・投資撤退・制裁運動の手法に許しがたいほど依拠している」と記されていた。

この声明が公表されることはなかった。ホワイトハウスや国務省の上層部から支持されなかったという。

ルビオ氏は８日、特定の国に対する率直な批判は控え、記者団に対し「当然ながら、われわれは英国が取ったような措置は取らない。本日、これらの国の発表を目にしたが、現時点ではそれについてコメントするつもりはない」と述べた。

今回の出来事は、イスラエルの入植地拡大への対応で、ホワイトハウスとイスラエル駐在の外交官の間で溝が深まっていることを浮き彫りにしている。

ホワイトハウスはコメント要請に応じなかった。

Pakistan says it launched air strikes on Afghanistan in response to drone attacks

The strikes come as tensions escalate between the allies-turned-foes, who have long been at odds over attacks by Islamist militants.

Reuters

24 September, 2026 11:35 am IST

Facebook

Twitter

WhatsApp

Linkedin

Representational Image | A man retrieves belongings from the debris of a house that was damaged in what the Taliban said was a Pakistani airstrike in Kunar province, Afghanistan, September 21, 2026. REUTERS/Stringer

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

Pakistan conducted airstrikes on 10 locations in Afghanistan that it said were being used to launch and store drones, some of which had been used against Pakistan a day earlier, Information Minister Attaullah Tarar said on Thursday.

The strikes come as tensions escalate between the allies-turned-foes, who have long been at odds over attacks by Islamist militants, which also triggered their worst fighting in years in February.

Islamabad accuses Kabul of harbouring militants who stage cross-border attacks, but Afghanistan’s Taliban government denies harbouring anti- Pakistan i insurgents and says militancy is Pakistan ‘s internal problem.

Show Full Article

Pakistan ‘s air defence systems detected drones launched from Afghan territory on Wednesday, which were tracked and neutralised before they could reach any of their intended targets, Tarar said in a post on X.

Pakistan then conducted the “precision aerial and drone strikes” on 10 locations, which were “limited to identified military objectives” linked to the attempted attacks, he said.

“Any further provocative act by Afghan Taliban will be responded with firm and resolute response,” the minister said.

The Pakistan i airstrikes were conducted in several areas of the southeastern Khost province, Mustaghfir Gurbaz, spokesperson for the Khost governor, said.

There were no casualties, he said.

An attack on a police facility in northwestern Pakistan last week, which killed at least 24 people, has reignited fighting between the countries after nearly three months of relative calm.

Pakistan ‘s government earlier this week also said it had launched airstrikes in the Afghanistan- Pakistan border region, killing 28 militants, while Afghan Taliban officials accused Islamabad of killing three civilians in overnight strikes on Afghan territory.

The worst single incident, however, occurred in March, when more than 400 people were killed in a Pakistan i airstrike on Kabul, which the Afghan Taliban said hit a drug rehabilitation centre.

Islamabad denied the charge, saying it “precisely targeted military installations and terrorist support infrastructure”.

(Reporting by Carlos Méndez in Mexico City and Sayed Hassib in Kabul; Writing by Sakshi Dayal; Editing by Clarence Fernandez and Lincoln Feast.)

item.title: H&M operating profit improves but sales still sluggish
item.description: Swedish fashion retailer H&M on Thursday reported a stronger-than-expected third-quarter operating profit as CEO Daniel Erver said his push to control costs and make sourcing more efficient was bearing fruit.
item.dc:creator: Greta Fondahn, Helen Reid
item.content:encoded: Swedish fashion retailer H&M (HMb.ST) on Thursday reported a stronger-than-expected third-quarter operating profit as CEO Daniel Erver said his push to control costs and make sourcing more efficient was bearing fruit. Since Erver became CEO in January 2024, H&M's profitability has improved, but investors are still waiting for signs he can boost sales growth in the face of fierce competition from Shein (0625.HK) and Zara owner Inditex (ITX.MC) . Operating profit in H&M's fiscal third quarter increased to 6.04 billion Swedish crowns ($608.63 million) from 4.91 billion crowns a year earlier and compared with a mean forecast of 5.14 billion crowns in an LSEG poll of analysts. H&M's gross profit margin widened to 54.0% in the quarter, from 52.9% a year earlier, thanks in part to tariff refunds. Analysts had expected a margin of 53.4%. Sales were still sluggish, though, with H&M saying sales in September would rise by 1% in local currencies — the same growth rate as the June-August quarter. H&M shares were down 2% at the open. "They are still struggling to lift sales growth," said Inderes analyst Lucas Mattsson, adding that profit was "relatively in line" with the markets' expectations adjusted for the tariff refund effects. H&M is increasing the share of clothes it buys in-season as it tries to react faster to fashion trends and increasingly unpredictable weather. But inventories were up 9% in currency-adjusted terms in the quarter, which H&M said was due to disruption in global supply chains. The retailer is also investing in logistics as online sales grow, and said it would gradually start using new warehouses in Europe this year and next to improve its capacity and product availability. Meanwhile, the billionaire heirs of H&M founder Erling Persson have been quietly [USN:L8N45A1AU TEXT:"increasing their stake"], fuelling speculation they could eventually take the group private. ($1 = 9.9239 Swedish crowns)

item.title: Indonesia court reduces Gojek founder's sentence to 9 years in appeal hearing
item.description: An Indonesian court has reduced the prison sentence of Gojek founder and former education minister Nadiem Makarim to 9 years from 10 years in an appeal hearing for a graft conviction relating to improper laptop procurement, judges said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Indonesian court has reduced the prison sentence of Gojek founder and former education minister Nadiem Makarim to 9 years from 10 years in an appeal hearing for a graft conviction relating to improper laptop procurement, judges said on Thursday. Nadiem was sentenced to 10 years in prison in June after the court found him guilty of abusing his authority during the procurement of Google (GOOGL.O) Chromebooks for schools in Indonesia that led to $125 million in state losses. He filed an appeal on July 1 to the Jakarta high court. One judge, Catur Iriantoro, said on Thursday that they did not approve Nadiem's appeal to dismiss all charges because the previous ruling was consistent with the facts established at trial, the evidence presented, and witness testimony. The court also cut the amount of restitution Nadiem must pay from 809 billion rupiah ($45.23 million) to 548 billion rupiah, another judge, Subachran Hardi Mulyana, said. After the hearing, Nadiem expressed his disappointment about the ruling and told reporters he would file another appeal to the Supreme Court. "The victim now is not just me, but the credibility of the law enforcement system in Indonesia," he said. Judges also upheld a previous ruling that said Makarim had adjusted the tender requirements to favour Chrome, which benefited Google and restricted competition. ($1 = 17,888 rupiah)

item.title: NSE stock lists: Macquarie, PL Capital begin coverage; see up to 9% upside
item.description: At their target price, Macquarie said, the NSE stock would trade at a 2.5x PEG, broadly in line with global peers, suggesting the premium is justified on a growth-adjusted basis.
item.dc:creator: Puneet Wadhwa
item.content:encoded: Domestic and foreign brokerages have started coverage on the NSE stock that listed on Thursday. Macquarie initiated coverage with an ‘outperform’ rating calling it ‘The Dominator’ due its leading market share and power, it has set a price target of Rs 1,965 for the stock. Domestic brokerage PL Capital, too, has initiated coverage on the counter with an ‘accumulate’ rating and a price target of Rs 1,950 per share. “Our target price of Rs 1,965 is based on 32.5x FY29E PER, justified by opportunities in India's financialisation journey and NSE's positioning as a dominant market infra provider,” wrote Samneet Sinha of Macquarie in a report dated 24 September. The NSE stock listed on Thursday at the BSE and the Metropolitan Stock Exchange of India (MSEI) at Rs 1,800 apiece, up around 0.84 per cent from its issue price of Rs 1,785 per share.  ALSO READ: NSE breaks into top 10 BSE market-cap league on debut; beats HUL, Titan For NSE, Macquarie forecasts a 12 per cent revenue CAGR over FY26-30E, in line with the market, driven by non-transaction revenues and new products, partly offset by modest share losses in cash equities and F&O.  While NSE trades at a 65 per cent P/E premium to international exchanges (30x FY29E vs 18x), the Macquarie report said, it delivers around 60 per cent higher growth and returns (compared to international peers), supported by India's structural financialisation tailwinds.  At their target price, Macquarie said, the NSE stock would trade at a 2.5x PEG, broadly in line with global peers, suggesting the premium is justified on a growth-adjusted basis.  “The stock is valued at 22x FY29E EV/EBITDA and 29.5x FY29E PER, as per its ‘cap price’ of the prospectus price band, reflecting its marquee positioning in the ecosystem. Potential for rerating could come from traction in new products, which would be upside to our estimates,” Sinha wrote. Financial snapshot source: Macquarie report At the operating level, NSE’s Ebitda margin, according to analysts at PL Capital, contracted to 71.3 per cent in FY26 from 77.8 per cent in FY25 due to settlement payments related to pending legal cases. With these cases now resolved, they expect Ebitda margin to normalize to 76 per cent by FY29E.  ALSO READ: NSE debut disappoints: Can it deliver long-term gains? Experts weigh in Profit after tax (PAT), they said in a 24 September report, is expected to grow at 11 per cent CAGR over FY26-29E with FY29E return of equity (RoE) of 35 per cent, and supported by a capital-light, high-margin business model. Key risk to their estimates include lower volumes due to regulatory hurdles/ market volatility. “We expect valuation to sustain at these levels, supported by structural factors such as near-dominance in key segments with high entry barriers; healthy profit growth (11 per cent CAGR over FY26-FY29E); and optionality from new derivative products/colocation revenue. We value NSE at 35x FY29E P/E to arrive at a target price of Rs 1,950,” wrote Shreya Khandelwal, Dhanik Hegde and Harshada Gite of PL Capital in the report. NSE’s initial public offering (IPO) was subscribed 5.71x overall, with bids received for 505.8 million shares against 88.6 million shares on offer for nearly ₹22,560 crore offer for sale, according to data on BSE.

item.title: Trump’s White House media ban blocked by US judge: What it means for CNN, MS NOW, Politico
item.description: Trump-appointed Judge Timothy Kelly ordered the White House to immediately restore press access for CNN, MS NOW and Politico, ruling the ban likely violated due process and First Amendment rights.
item.dc:creator: Bhanu Pratap
item.content:encoded: A US federal judge has ordered the Donald Trump administration to restore White House access to journalists from CNN, MS NOW and Politico, ruling that the ban was likely unconstitutional, Reuters reported.US District Judge Timothy Kelly issued the order in a lawsuit filed by the three news organisations challenging the administration’s decision to bar them from White House access.In a post on Truth Social, Trump had accused the three organisations of repeatedly publishing what he described as “FICTION and LIES”.The US Department of Justice had argued that the administration’s decision was justified on national-security grounds, CNBC reported.According to CNBC, DOJ lawyers told the court that “access to the White House is a privilege — not a right”. The department also said Trump had determined that the outlets had reported classified or sensitive national security information.What did CNN, MS NOW and Politico argue?The three organisations filed a lawsuit in federal court in Washington, DC, arguing that the restrictions amounted to unlawful retaliation for constitutionally protected speech, Reuters reported.They also accused the administration of violating their due-process rights.“This ban could not be a more direct assault on the First Amendment nor a more blatant violation of our most fundamental constitutional principles,” the organisations said, as per the statement cited by Reuters.White House says access is not a rightThe White House has maintained that the affected organisations can continue to cover the administration without direct access to the Oval Office or other White House spaces.It argued that journalists from the outlets could report from outside the White House and said they should not be able to demand access to the president’s office.“The Fake News has no place demanding a spot in the President’s Oval Office,” the White House said in a statement, accusing the outlets of spreading what it called lies and saying their reporting harmed the American public.What happens next?Judge Timothy Kelly, who was appointed by Trump, is overseeing the case and has ordered the restoration of access as the legal challenge proceeds.The court proceedings will now hinge between the administration’s national-security justification for the restrictions and the media organisations’ First Amendment claims.In his decision, Judge Kelly, a Trump appointee, emphasised that the administration violated the reporters' due process rights.Citing past case law, he ruled that the government cannot revoke a journalist's hard pass without advance notice of an infraction and a fair opportunity to be heard, as per Reuters.Kelly ordered the administration to “immediately” restore access, but it remains to be seen how the White House will react.
